description: Scheduled Tasks GPO authored via GPMC Editor — Machine scope (TaskV2 update, ImmediateTaskV2 create, TaskV2 replace with multiple triggers) and User scope (TaskV2 create with Unicode/ShowMessage/SessionStateChangeTrigger/FilterDomain, TaskV2 delete with SendEmail action)
classification_note: Authored through gpme.msc on Windows Server 2025 and captured via Backup-GPO. GPMC natively emitted TaskV2 and ImmediateTaskV2 elements.

origin.method: Backup-GPO on Windows Server 2025 build 26100, PowerShell 5.1

items.windows_meaning: Update scheduled task 'GpoStudio-Cleanup': runs cleanmgr.exe /sagerun:1 daily at 02:00 as NT AUTHORITY\System. CalendarTrigger with ScheduleByDay interval 1.

Create immediate task 'GpoStudio-Init': runs cmd.exe /c echo init once at logon. TimeTrigger with %LocalTimeXmlEx% boundaries. Settings: AllowHardTerminate, StartWhenAvailable, ExecutionTimeLimit P3D, DeleteExpiredTaskAfter PT0S.

Replace scheduled task 'Replace Test': runs notepad.exe as NT AUTHORITY\System with HighestAvailable. Two CalendarTriggers: weekly (Sunday) and monthly (Day 1, all months, disabled). Tests multiple trigger support.

Create user-scope task 'Create Task': runs notepad.exe with Unicode arguments. ShowMessage action with Unicode title/body. TimeTrigger + SessionStateChangeTrigger (RemoteConnect). FilterDomain ILT targets HRAENET. RestartOnFailure configured. MultipleInstancesPolicy StopExisting.
Delete user-scope task 'Delete Test'. SendEmail action configured (from/to/subject/body/server). Empty Triggers element. Tests delete action with SendEmail action type.

parser_gaps.gap: parse_gpp_scheduled_tasks searches for <Task> elements but GPMC emits <TaskV2> — zero items found
parser_gaps.impact: All TaskV2 items are invisible to the scheduled tasks parser
parser_gaps.note: Fixed: parser now searches for both <TaskV2> and <Task> elements

parser_gaps.gap: GppImmediateTask.program is empty because the parser reads Properties attributes which GPMC does not populate; actual command lives in Task Scheduler 2.0 XML subtree
parser_gaps.impact: Immediate task command/arguments are lost on the flat model path

parser_gaps.gap: collect_gpp_collections does not discover ScheduledTasks/ScheduledTasks.xml from backup directories
parser_gaps.impact: Scheduled task items are not imported via the public backup path
parser_gaps.note: Fixed: collect_gpp_collections now discovers all GPP adapter files

parser_gaps.gap: No model support for ShowMessage or SendEmail task action types
parser_gaps.impact: Non-Exec task actions are silently dropped
Session state change triggers cannot be represented
